tei:div.tei:p: ('a)༄༅// sa skya'i rje btsun sku mched kyi lta ba'i bzhed tshul bzhugs so// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag byas nas// stong pa nyid kyi chos tshul la// sa skya'i rje btsun mched gnyis kyi// bzhed pa'i mthar thug 'dir bshad bya// rigs pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid dang*// rang bzhin gyi ni stong pa nyid// dang po thos bsam shes rab kyis// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i grub don te// gnyis pa sgom byung ye shes kyis// nyams su myong bya de kho na// dang po sgom pas myong bya dang*// phyi ma rigs pas dpyad pa yis// gnas lugs yin pa'i shes byed ni// mdo lung ji bzhin 'dir bshad bya// stong nyid med par dgag pa'i cha// rnal 'byor mngon sum gyis myong na// med dgag dngos por 'gyur ba dang*// yul can rtog par thal phyir ro// des na rim gnyis rnal 'byor pas// nyams su myong bya'i stong nyid ni// rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin te// lha dang sngags kyi rgyu nyid do// de yang rigs pas dpyad pa yi// stong pa nyid du mi 'dod de// stong nyid 'phags pa'i shes mthong gis// mdzad pa nyid du thal phyir ro// rgyud du rang bzhin stong nyid la// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa dang*// zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa gnyis// dang po phar phyin theg pa dang*// brjod bya'i gtso bo thun mong ba// gnyis pa bla med theg pa yi// khyad chos nyid phyir de rtogs pa'i// thabs kyang gzhan du ma grags pa// nyid phyir thun mong min par 'chad// rang bzhin lhan skyes rtogs pa'i thabs// phar phyin theg par gang bshad pa// mi pham byams pas 'byed gnyis su// gsal bar gsungs pa de yin no// bla med theg par gsungs pa ni// thos bsam blo dang rtags dpe la// ma ltos par yang bum dbang las// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par gsungs// 'o na rang byin rlabs pa la// ltos pa med par rmi lam dang*// rgyu 'dra rtogs pa med do zhes// gsal bar gsungs pa ci zhe na// de ni zhu bde lhan skyes la// nges par dgongs pa nyid yin te// de nyid rdo rje theg pa yi// nges don mthar thug yin phyir ro// de yi shes byed ci zhe na// thog mar spyod pas goms byas pa'i// zhu bde'i ye shes de kho na// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nye rgyu'i phyir// ngo bo gnyis med smra ba yis// gtan la phab pa'i stong nyid ni// gzhung de nyid du'ang mthar thug gi

/don dam bden par mi 'chad na// theg pa mchog tu smos ci dgos// 'on kyang de yi rigs pa ni// mnyam gzhag spros pa'i mtha' bral du// 'chad tshe dgos pa khyad par 'phags// de ltar bshad pas grub pa ni// rje btsun mched kyi gzhung lugs su// mtha' bral 'chad tshe don dam gyi// ngos bzung ci yang med pa dang*// nyams len tshe na zung 'jug gi /don dam bden pa ngos bzung nas// de la dgyes pa rdo rje sogs// ming gi rnam grangs bcu bzhir bshad// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yis// stong nyid shes par mi 'dod cing*// theg pa mchog gi rtse mo pas// shes par 'dod pa'i khyad par ni// gnas skabs sems las ma gtogs pa'i// shes bya 'dod dang mi 'dod pa'i// khyad par nyid yin theg mchog tu// kun kyang chos dbyings ye shes so// 'khor lo tha ma sgra ji bzhin// khas len byed pa'i dbu ma pa'i// chos nyid ngos 'dzin gsang sngags dang*// rang bzhin lhan skyes nyid du mthun// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs su// gcig dang du bral rigs pa yis// rang bzhin lhan skyes rang steng du// gtan la phebs pa ci zhe na// de ltar 'chad pa mthar 'dzin gyi// rtog pa 'gog pa'i phyir yin te// nyams su myong bya rnam kun gyi// mchog ldan stong nyid kho na'o// de skad du yang 'jam dpal gyi// lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan du// phung po rnam bcad stong pa nyid// chu shing bzhin du snying po med// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin// zhes gsungs pa der rnam bcad kyi// stong nyid bsgom bya min par gsungs// de tshe dgos pa ci zhe na// gcig dang du ma gang rung du// 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog zlog phyir te// gnyis ka rtog par mtshungs phyir ro// 'o na gcig dang du bral gyi// rigs pa dngos po'i gnas lugs la// zhugs pa min par nyid 'gyur te// bden grub khas blangs phyir zhe na// sgra dang rtog pa'i yul gyur pa// kun la rtog dpyod de 'jug mod// rnam shes yul las 'das pa'i chos// rdo rje nyid phyir sgra rtog gis// gzhom du yod pa ma yin no// la la sngags kyi theg pa 'dir// ye shes bden grub khas blangs pas// sems tsam lugs su 'gyur zhe na// de ni khyab pa 'gal gyur te// ji srid gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa// khas len med pa de srid du// ye shes nyid kyang mi srid na// de yi khyad chos ji ltar 'chad// gzung 'dzin gnyis med khas len pa// de ni dbu ma pa nyid las// sems tsam sogs la mi srid par// rje btsun mched kyis bshad phyir ro// la la rgyud gsum dgongs pa yang*// sems tsam nyid du gnas zhes zer// 'dzin pa bden med khas len pa'i// sems tsam pa de gang nas btsal// byams chos phyi mar bshad ce na// de nyid sems tsam gzhung yin par// lung dang rigs pa gang gis sgrub// zla ba grags pa'i lung dang ni// bden dngos khas len phyir zhe na// 'o na khyed kyi dbu ma yang*// chad par smra ba'i lta ba dang*// skur 'debs lta ba'i lam 'gyur te// thogs med zhabs kyis der bshad phyir// zla grags lung nyid len byed na// snang ba thams cad sems yin zhes// zer ba myur du 'dor dgos te// de yis de nyid bkag phyir ro// tshad mas grub dang bden pa dang*// bden grub rnams la khyed dbye ba// sngon rabs mkhas pa'i gzhung na med// gsum ka bslu med don phyir ro// zhes pa rje btsun mched gnyis kyi// lta ba'i skabs kyi lung rnams la// de gzhung 'gog byed phyi rabs pa// gzhan blo'i dri mas sbags pa 'ga'// rang gzhung chos 'khor gsum pa yi// lung dang mthun pa ma yin par// chos 'khor bar pa sgra ji bzhin// 'chad pa kho na mchog mthong ba// de dag rje btsun mched bcas la// 'khrul zad ces pa'i gcam bsngags tsam// lhur blangs pa yis gzhan mgu byed// rnams kyi rmongs pa bsal phyir yin// de las skyes pa'i rnam dkar po// rnam dpyod bgrangs yas 'phro byed 'dis// thog mar rang blo'i rmongs bsal nas// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel shog

/gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dpal// kun dga'i bshes gnyen rje btsun gyi// gdan sar 'bel gtam rnam nges pa'i// don du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa// blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan kyang*// nges don phal cher dngos smra yi// gzhung du drangs pa'i nyes pa las// rnam grol nges pa'i don mthong shog/ // ༄// chos grwa'i dgos spyod kyi dris lan// byang sems 'phags pa'i 'gog lam ni// chos rnam gnyis po gtan du ba'i// skyabs min zhes pa der ni 'dus// ci phyir zhe na gtan du ba'i// skyabs dang dam pa'i don gyi skyabs// rdzogs sangs rgyas su 'dus phyir ro// byang sems 'phags pa'i lam bden la// bslu phyir zhes pa'i don gang de// tshang dang ma tshang gnyis su dbye// ci phyir zhe na don dam dang*// kun rdzob gnyis su dbye phyir ro// mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa// ma rig pa yi bag chags kyis// 'dus ma byas phyir bslu ba min// rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa// de las log phyir bslu chos can// byang sems 'phags pa'i 'gog bden la// med phyir zhes pa'i don ma tshang*// ci phyir zhe na de yi don// med dgag nyid la bshad phyir dang*// byang 'phags 'gog bden chos kyi sku// yon tan mang pos brgyan phyir ro// 'on kyang mthar thug skyabs min pa'i// shes byed de yi gong nyid na// chos sku chen po bzhugs phyir ro// // ༄༅// spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa// thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang po// yid 'ong rgyal ba'i sras kyi skur bstan nas// ma lus 'gro ba kun gyi yab gyur pa// tshad med snying rje gter la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las mi bzhengs kyang*// byams dang snying rje'i 'od dkar phreng ba can// 'gro don yangs pa'i mkha' la rtag 'char bas// 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel la phyag 'tshal lo// grangs med rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje'i gter// ngo mtshar mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs nas// nyams thag 'gro ba mang po rjes 'dzin pa// kun gyis bsngags par 'os la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang drang srong rig sngags grub pa dang*// sa skyong rgyal po'i tshul dang gzhon nu'i sku// bstan pa 'dzin mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi// rnam rol du mar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i rgya mtsho ring nas brgal gyur kyang*// zhi ba'i gnas su yud tsam mi bzhugs pa'i// rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pas 'khyud pa'i tshems dkar dpag bsam las// snying rje'i 'dzum phreng phyogs bcur gsal ba na// gang la phan dang bde ba'i lam chen por// dad pa'i shing rtas 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo// stong pa'i ngang las sems nyid 'od gsal ba// spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i skur bskyed nas// snying po'i rig sngags mang du bzlas pa dang*// gang la gus pas gsol ba'i dge ba 'dis// rmongs pa'i gnyid chen dus su sad pa dang*// 'khor ba'i rmi lam rang sar dag pa dang*// 'od gsal nyi ma dus su 'char ba dang*// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skems par shog

/skye ba'i nyi ma lan mang shar gyur kyang*// 'chi bdag mun pa'i lam las ma grol bar// nam yang rmongs pa'i lam du 'jug byed mkhan// ye shes nyi ma 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// stong nyid snying rjes 'khyud pa'i zla ba ni// yid kyi chu sngon dwangs pa'i mtshor shar bas// gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i rnyog pa kun bsal te// snying rje'i chu gter chen por bdag gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rigs bzang po'i// chu gter dbus su rnam dpyod kyi// nor bus brgyan pa'i klu dbang po// dpal ldan srid zhi'i dbang phyug gi /'byor pa'i bang mdzod 'dzin de'i ngor// sde snod 'dzin pa'i chos kyi grwa// rab yangs gser mdog can de nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros kyis// rigs par phul ba 'di bzhes cig/ //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //gangs can gyi chen po snga phyir byon pa'i lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam bzhag rang gzhung gsal ba'i me long zhes pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru pad+ma badz+ra ya/ bod yul du byon gsang sngags la// snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur dag tu grags// dang po slob dpon sprul pa'i skus// thugs nas gsungs pa lo ts+tshas bsgyur// phyi dus lo ts+tsha chen po yis// rgyud gzhung 'gyur nas gsang sngags la// gsar rnying du grags 'phags yul na// brda skad de ltar cung ma grags// snga 'gyur sems phyogs sgyu 'phrul dang*// mdo sde gsum du phal cher 'dus// sems phyogs yul gyi gnas lugs te// sgyu 'phrul lhag pa'i lha sgrub thabs// mdo sde kun la khyab byed du// 'jug pa phyi dus zhig na 'gyur// yul gyi gnas lugs 'khor ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i phyogs kyis dbye// 'khor ba byed po kun gzhi yi// rnam shes nyid las gzhan du med// myang 'das byed po kun gzhi yi// ye shes nyid yin de yi mtshan// gab pa mngon pa phyung ba dang*// rdzogs pa chen po zhes su btags// de mngon byed pa'i thabs mchog ni// lung dang rigs pa lus kyi gnad// kho nas ma yin rang rig gi

/man ngag bla mas bstan pa dang*// yi ger bris pa kun na gsal// rdzogs pa che la thun mong dang*// thun mong min pa rnam gnyis las// dang po phar phyin theg pa dang*// phyi ma gsang sngags bla med do// rnying ma pa la phar phyin dang*// rgyud sde rnam gsum gsar ma las// logs su mi 'chad rnying mar ni// grags pa bla med kho na'o// de la rnal 'byor chen po dang*// rjes su rnal 'byor shin tu yang*// rnal 'byor gsum las rdzogs pa che// nyid la a ti yo gar 'chad// theg pa rim pa dgu kun la// lta ba rdzogs pa chen po res// zin pa dgos phyir gang zag dang*// chos kyi bdag tu rmongs pa sel// de phyir rnying ma'i sgom pa la// dbang sgom med ces smra ba 'khrul// slob dpon sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi// dngos slob grub chen skar ma'i grangs// sgyu 'phrul las ni yang dag dang*// phur pa la sogs rang rang gi /skyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin nas// a ti yo ga nyid la 'jug /de sgrub byed dang grub rtags su// sbyor sgrol gnyis po de'i ngos 'dzin// phyag rgya la dad rnam par shes// dbyings su sgrol ba la 'chad dang*// bsad dang gso la ngos 'dzin pa// byung ngo de tshe sbyor sgrol gnyis// log pa dang ni yang dag pa'i// kun rdzob dbye bas so sor 'byed// phyag rgya dang sbyor rdzogs pa che// skyed dang mthar phyin thabs mchog ste// sgrol ba rdzogs pa che'i ye shes// mngon du gyur las gzhan gyis min// rdzogs chen ye shes la rol kyang*// yang dag kun rdzob khyad bsad na// 'khrul pa'i snang ba las byung ba'i// sdug bsngal gsum po rgyun mi chad// de phyir sangs rgyas ma thob pa// de srid rdzogs pa chen po dang*// yang dag kun rdzob zung sbrel du// nyams su blangs pas lam mthar phyin// 'di ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i// lung gi don dang nyams len gnad// 'khrul med yin no de bshad pa'i// rnam dkar kun tu bzang por bsngo// shu bhaṃ//

rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas// sde snod 'dzin pa sher tshul gyi// dris pa dang ni de yi lan// go rim bzhin du brjod bya ba// las lam gsum gyi de dus kyi// kun slong zhe sdang nyid yin phyir// mngon spyod las de gang la dgongs// sbyor sgrol 'gog pa de ci zhig /ces pa de yi lan 'di yin// stong nyid rtogs pa'i gsang sngags pas// chags dang zhe sdang lam byed pa// de tshe de yis kun bslangs pa'i// las de thams cad dge bar nges// sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa yi// dug ltar nyes pa mi skyed pa'i// kun slong dge ba dang mtshungs ldan// sbyor sgrol zhes pa bsad gso dang*// srog gcod log g.yem la 'chad pa'i// skabs gnyis yod do dang po de// mthu ldan dbang byas dge ba yin// gnyis pa de yang stong pa nyid// rtogs tshe chags sdang lam byed yin// de ma rtogs pas de byed pa// lo chen rin chen bzang pos bkag /srung 'khor la sogs drag las kyis// rnam rtog gsod pa yin na ni// sngon du gzung ba ma bkag par// 'dzin pa 'gog par 'thad dam ci// zhes pa'i lan yang 'di yin te// rgyud las srog chags bsad par bya// zhes pa'i tshig la drang don dang*// nges don bshad pa rnam gnyis yod// dang po bsgral ba'i zhing bcu po// tshang ba'i sems can gsod pa ste// tshar bcad rjes 'dzin nus pa yis// lta stangs grub pa'i tshe na yin// gnyis pa gzung dang 'dzin pa yi// rnam par rtog pa gsod pa ste// gsang sngags kun spyod ji snyed pa// rtog med ye shes nyid las bsgrubs// yul can rtog pa 'gog byed pa// de yul bkag la rag las shes// bya ba 'di ni mtshan nyid pa'i// lugs yin gsang sngags pa la med// dbu ma'i rigs pas ma dpyad par// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang*// ye shes phab dang dbang bskur dang*// lus bcing pa las rnam rtog khebs// rang gzhan rnam rtog ye shes kyi// rdo rje min nam gsod pa ci// zhes pa de lan kun rdzob dang*// spang bya nyid phyir der mi 'dod// snang grags chos kun rang sems las// logs su med na sems can kun// ma byas pa dang phrad 'jig dang*// 'bad med grol bar mi 'gyur ram// zhes pa de lan ji srid du// 'khrul pa'i bag chags ma byang ba// de srid sangs rgyas sems can dang*// rang gzhan dge sdig sna tshogs 'char// 'khrul pa'i bag chags dag pa na// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan med phyir sangs rgyas dang*// sems can rgyud gzhan so sor med// 'khrul snang las snang ma byang ba// de srid kun rdzob chos rnams yod// de tshe dge sdig blang dor gyis// 'khrul ngor bde sdug so sor myong*// 'khrul snang bsod nams tshogs chen dang*// nyams snang sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// rang snang bde chen chos sku dang*// gzhan snang sgyu ma'i sprul pa 'char// rgyu rgyud kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings// thabs rgyud lam yang chos dbyings te// 'bras rgyud spangs rtogs chos kyi dbyings// de phyir chos dbyings las gzhan med// pha rol phyin pa'i bsod nams tshogs// yang dag kun rdzob thad sor 'jog

/sngags kyi bsod nams chos dbyings kyi// ye shes nyid las bsgrubs pa'i phyir// lam la zab dang mi zab dang*// myur bul khyad par shin tu che// chos dbyings yod dang yod min zhes// bya ba sngags kyi rjes thob dang*// pha rol phyin pa'i rjes thob kyi// tha snyad 'dogs pa'i khyad par yin// bla med theg pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gdod ma nyid nas grub pa yi// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams// grub zin gsal 'debs yin par ni// zhes pa de lan 'chang 'jug gi /khyad par yin no rgol ba'i tshe// rang gi chos nyid dang rnam pa// sangs rgyas dngos yin 'chad pa'i tshe// mtshan dpe stobs sogs yon tan tshogs// zhen pas 'jug pa de kun yang*// dri mas bsgribs phyir rang rang gi /don byed nus pa nyid du med// mdor na khyed kyi nyams len ni// rnam shes ngo na gang snang ba// de nyid snang tsam der zhog la// ye shes kyis ni 'dzin med byos// skyed rim rtog pa'i sgom min nam// zhe na rtog la gang shar ba// de yang der snang der zhog la// rtog pa gzhan gyis 'dzin med byos// de ltar bshad pas gzung 'dzin gyi// spros pa rang sar dag gyur nas// gnyis med ye shes bde mchog gi /rang zhal myur du mthong bar shog/ //shu bhaṃ/// / ༄༅// swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gangs can ljongs su gsang sngags la// gsar rnying zhes byar grags pa'i don// phyis byon mkhas pas gang bzhed pa// mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'dir brjod bya// 'phags pa'i yul du gsang sngags kyi// rgyud dang 'grel pa bstan bcos dang*// de 'dzin byed po'i gang zag la// gsar rnying zhes byar dbye ba med// bod du grub chen mtsho skyes kyis// zab don thugs las gang phyung ba// rim par nyams su blangs pa las// grub pa brnyes rnams byon pa dang*// dgongs don 'chad pa'i bstan bcos kyi// tshogs la rgyud du mtshan gsol ba// gang zhig bod yul du byon pa'i// mkhas dang mkhas min mang pos mdzad// 'di yi rtsom gzhi rang rgyud la// rtogs pa 'khrungs pa'ang yin mod kyi// gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa// snga 'gyur rgyud kun la yang brten// 'dus pa'i shin tu rnal 'byor la// a ti yo gar mtshan gsol nas// dam chos gab pa mngon phyung dang*// rdzogs pa chen po zhes byar grags// 'di yi lta ba 'khrul med ni// bla med rgyud rnams kun dang mthun// bden gnyis rnam 'byed mi shes pa// 'ga' yis log par brtags zhes grags// la la rdzogs chen rgya nag gi

/mkhan po'i chos lugs yin zer mod// a ti yo ga gsang sngags kyi// chos yin cig shos der mi 'chad// sems phyogs phal cher sems tsam gyi// lta bar 'chad po de dag gis// bla med rgyud kun nas gsungs pa'i// lta ba ji bzhin 'chad mi nus// mu stegs byed kyi lta ba dang*// sgrub lugs mthun par yod zer mod// rang byin rlabs dang phyag rgya'i lam// mu stegs byed la yod mod kyang*// sdug bsngal ba dang bdag med gtam// gang na yod pa'i man ngag gi /lta ba 'khrul par dogs mi dgos// de phyir bdag med nyid btsal bya// la la rnying ma'i skyed rim du// dag pa sgom pa ma bshad zer// sngon 'gro'i dus su stong pa nyid// bsgom pas de don nges par 'grub// rgyu yi rdo rje 'dzin pa yang*// ma bshad pas na 'khrul zer mod// bod yul mngal skyes sbyong ba yi// thabs tsam bstan pas dgos pa 'grub// dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha tshogs la// 'byung po mang du bkod zer mod// bod kyi 'byung po lhar bskyed pa// 'phags pa'i yul du ma grags kyang*// gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod phyir// 'byung po'i go 'phang bstod pa dang*// skabs 'gar 'jig rten 'das pa yang*// 'jig rten pa ltar sgrub pa mang*// lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad// ces pa 'phags pa'i yul du yang*// rtsod pa med par grags pa yi// gzhung lugs dag na bshad pa yod// rnying ma'i lta sgom 'khrul med ni// rgyal ba'i dgongs dang rig 'dzin brda// gang zag snyan brgyud du 'chad phyir// rgya dpe tshol ba'i ngal mi dgos// de lta na yang rgyud min zhes// khungs phyung bstan bcos du ma ni// gsar rnying kun la yod pas na// rtog dpyod mdzad po mang zhig byon// gsang sngags thugs las 'gyur ba dang*// dpe las bsgyur la gsar rnying zhes// tha snyad 'dogs pa'i lugs gcig dang*// sngon dus 'gyur dang phyi dus su// rin chen bzang po byon tshun chad// 'gyur la gsar rnying zhes bya bar// tha snyad 'dogs pa'i lugs gnyis las// snga ma don la gnas pa ste// phyi ma'i lugs su'ang 'chad pa'i tshe// snga 'gyur sde snod rnam gsum dang*// rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i glegs bam kun// rnying ma'i chos su bshad na legs// rdzun min gter gyi chos lugs ni// byin rlabs stobs kyi 'byung ba ste// gang la lung bstan yod pa de// dgongs pa'i rgyud du shes par bya// gsar 'gyur chos rnams dar rjes su// rnying ma'i chos lugs ma 'khrul ba'i// bstan bcos gsar du mdzad pa yang*// gang zag snyan brgyud du shes bya// tan+t+ra sde chen bco brgyad po// mkha' las babs dang rdo rje 'chang*// zhal mthong sgrub thabs la sogs pa// gsar pa'i chos la'ang bshad pa'i phyir// gter gyi chos dang rig 'dzin brda// la sogs bshad la snyems mi dgos// dus 'dir bshad pa gtso bo'i phyir// gsar ma'i chos lugs blang bar bya// gsar rnying gsang sngags gsung ba po'i// rdo rje 'chang dbang tha dad dang*// sprul sku shākya thub pa las// khyad 'phags zer sogs spang bar bya// de skad 'di ni rnying ma yi// chos lugs chos min zer ba dang*// bod du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kun// 'phags pa'i yul nas bsgyur zhes sogs// la las ha cang smad pa dang*// gzhan gyi ha cang bstod drags pa'i// ches cher thal ba kun spangs pa'i// dge bas rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/

//shu bhaṃ// ༈ /swasti sad+dhaṃ/ kha ba can du cher grags pa'i// chos lugs rnam gsum bka' gdams dang*// phyag rgya pa dang sa skya pa// gsum po'i lta sgom spyod pa yi// rnam par dbye ba 'dir bshad bya// dang po'i lta ba zla grags kyi// lugs yin nam mkha' lta bu yi// stong nyid med par dgag pa de// dbu ma'i man ngag las rtogs bya// spyod pa byams mgon thogs med kyis// mdo rgyan byang sa las bshad pa'i// 'jug pa'i sdom pa de bzung nas// phar phyin drug la slob pa'o// sgom pa'i tshul la lta ba dang*// man ngag ji bzhin sgom pa'o// dang po rigs pas dpyad pa na// chos gang ci yang ma rnyed pa'i// ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa la// stong nyid sgom pa zhes su btags// stong nyid mngon sum rjes dpag gi /rtogs bya min par a ti shas// bshad pa ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i dbu ma pa dang mthun// dbu ma'i man ngag ces bya dang*// zab mo lta ba'i rim pa dang*// dbu ma'i lta khrid ces bya ba// de las gzhan na yod ma yin// pu to ba yi dpyad sgom nyid// gtso bor bshad ces zer mod kyang*// sbyor ba'i dus su bsam byung gi /rigs par bshad kyi mnyam gzhag min// gzhan du a ti sha nyid kyi// man ngag gzhung dang 'gal bar 'gyur// man ngag sgom la phar phyin dang*// sngags kyi nyams len gcig pu bzhed// dang po la yang lta ba dang*// blo sbyong rim pa rnam gnyis so// dang po gong du bshad zin te// gnyis pa byang chub sems gnyis kyi// sgom la blo sbyong zhes grags pa// gser gling pa nas jo bo yi// thugs la 'phos nas rim pa bzhin// snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa de// 'chad kha ba yis yi ger bkod// de na don dam byang chub sems// sgom tshul rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*// mthun par 'chad pa rtsa tshig tu// gsal bar gsungs pa de yin no// kun rdzob byang chub sems sgom pa'i// tshul la smon pa sems bskyed dang*// 'jug pa'i sdom pa gnyis su 'chad// dang po cho gas skye srid kyang*// de yi sdom pa 'dir mi bzhed// smon la sdom pa bzhed gyur na// sems bskyed btang ba rtsa ba yi// ltung bar ma bshad pa dang 'gal// dper na spyod 'jug lugs bzhin no// sngags kyi man ngag sgom tshul la// gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ni// tshangs par spyod pas mi len zhes// gsungs la bka' gdams par grags mod// sna zur ba dang spyan snga sogs// bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum dang*// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// man ngag pa zhes grags pa'o// phyag rgya pa la bka' rgyud ces// grags pa zla 'od gzhon nu yi// bka' gdams lugs kyi tshul bzung nas// sgrub rgyud rgyal mtshan btsugs la grags// lugs 'di'i lta sgom spyod pa yang*// rtogs bya'i lta ba gnyis med kyi// ye shes myong ba rig tsam ste// 'di las ma gtogs chos 'ga' yang*// med phyir phyag rgya chen po dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang*// dngos po'i gnas lugs nyid kyi phyir// de myong rang rig lta bar bzhed// rtogs bya gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dus// kun la khyad par yod min kyang*// de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs mchog ni// mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs su// mi 'dra'i dbye ba mang bshad mod// khyad par 'phags pa bla ma yi// mos gus nyid phyir las dang pos// de la nan tan bya zhes bzhed// de tsam las byung gsal stong gi

/ye shes rgyun mi chad par yang*// bying rgod spangs nas goms byed pa// de nyid sgom pa yin par bzhed// 'di la dkar po chig thub ces// gsung yang 'di las bsod nams tshogs// sog pa ngang gis 'byung bar bzhed// stong nyid rtogs pa rten 'brel la// nges pa 'dren pa'i rgyud yin zhes// kun la grags pa nyid kyi phyir// 'di pas kyang ni de bzhed do// de la mar pa lo ts+tsha ni// dbang bskur las thob rim gnyis sgom// 'di la gtso bor rdzogs rim ste// dwags pos goms mdzad phyag rgya che// phag grus dang por lam 'bras dang*// phyi nas phyag rgya chen por goms// byin rlabs dang 'brel chos drug gis// slob ma'i tshogs rnams skyong bar mdzad// 'bri khung pas ni chig thub la// gzhan gyi nyes pa spang bya'i phyir// lnga ldan sgom gyi gtso bo dang*// so thar tshul khrims gces par 'dzin// tshul khrims mthar phyin stag lung pa// phyi dus dbang dang 'brel pa yi// phyag chen chos drug goms tshul dang*// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i chos lugs bzhed// karma pas ni chos drug dang*// phyag chen gtso bor bzhed mod kyi// mdo sngags gsar ma'i gzhung bzhin dang*// rnying ma'i chos lugs 'ga' zhig mdzad// yang dgon pa'i chos brgyud ni// bka' rgyud so so'i lugs mang dang*// lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa'ang*// tshul bzhin blangs nas sgrub rgyud spel// shangs pa'i phyag chen chos drug kyang*// rgyud pa so so las 'ongs mod// nā ro'i chos dang phal cher mthun// phyi dus rgyud pa'ang gcig tu bsres// dam pa'i sdug bsngal zhi byed ni// phal cher pha rol phyin pa'i chos// rang rig rang gsal zhal ngo blta// res 'ga' sngags su bkral ba'ang snang*// sa skya pas ni bka' phyag gi /rtsa ba'i chos de mi 'gog kyang*// chos kyis gdul bya khrid tshul la// lung rigs dpyad pa mang du mdzad// khyad par phyag rgya chen po ni// sngags lugs yin na dbang bzhi dgos// min na pha rol phyin pa yi// gzhung lugs sbyangs nas de goms bya// dbang bzhi bskur ba'i bla ma la// mos gus tsam gyis de rtogs kyang*// de las gzhan pa'i bla ma las// phyag rgya che rtogs mi srid gsung*// bka' gdams pa rnams mdo sngags kyi// khyad par ma phyed mang po dang*// 'jug sdom skye bo phal cher la// byed pa shin tu 'khrul zhes gsung*// rang lugs lta sgom spyod pa yi// rnam par dbye ba mdo tsam ni// rtogs bya'i lta ba dngos po yi// gnas lugs yin no de rtogs pa'i// shes rab lta ba yin no zhes// bshad na mngon pa'i chos dang mthun// mdo dang sngags gzhung mtha' dag tu// dngos po'i gnas lugs gcig nyid las// gzhan du bshad pa yod ma yin// gcig pu lhan skyes ye shes so// de rtogs byed pa'i thabs la ni// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa las// thos bsam las byung rigs pa dang*// tshul chen man ngag du mar bshad// thos bsam las byung lta ba la// thos pa'i lta ba zhes bya dang*// sgom pas nyams su myong bya la// rnam kun mchog ldan zhes su bshad// rigs pas gtan la gang phab pa// de nyid nyams su myong bya zhes// zer ba 'di pa'i lugs min te// de'i gsung kun dang 'gal phyir ro// thos bsam dus kyi stong pa nyid// dngos po'i gnas lugs ma yin te// de yi yul can rtog pa las// ma 'das phyir na de goms pas// dug can nyid du bshad phyir ro// ngo bo nyid med smra ba la// rab grags stong pa nyid gang ni// rigs pas ci yang ma rnyed tsam// de ni don dam dngos min mod// 'on kyang mtshan 'dzin 'gog pa yi// thabs la khyad par 'phags nyid phyir/

lta ba rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshe// thog mar de yang blang bar bya// nyams su myong bya'i stong nyid kyi// ye shes kho na byang phyogs so// yon tan kun gyi sgrub gzhi dang*// ngo bo bskyed nas yun ring du// goms par byas pas yon tan kun// ye shes de yi bdag nyid du// gsal bar 'char ba sgom yin no// spyod pa pha rol phyin pa dang*// sngags kyi kun spyod gnyis su 'chad// snga ma rnam shes yul du ni// gang shar chos rnams thams cad la// rigs pa'i dpyad pa ma bcug cing*// de nyid du yang 'dzin med pa'i// ngang nas byang chub sems mchog dang*// pha rol phyir drug spyod pa dang*// sems can yongs su smin pa dang*// sangs rgyas zhing kun sbyong bar byed// sngags su rnam shes yul gyi chos// thams cad mi dmigs bsams byas nas// ye shes nyid las grub pa yi// sngags kyi spyod pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs// sa skya pa la cher grags pa'i// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ni// phyi dus snang stong zung 'jug la// 'chad pa yod med de mi 'thad// dang por ye shes tshogs sog tshe// snang ba bkag nas stong nyid kyi// ye shes kho na sgom par bshad// snang stong zung 'brel lta ba yi// yul du 'chad la sngon gyi tshe// sgyu ma rigs sgrub pa zhes dang*// spros bral mi gnas pa zhes gsungs// spyir yang snang ba ye shes kyi// yul du mi dmigs pa de la// zung du 'jug pa zhes bshad kyi// stong bzhin snang la der mi 'chad// mdor na rje btsun sa skya pas// dbang bzhi po yi lta ba'i yul// bral cha tsam la mi 'chad kyi// ye shes kho nar bzhed pa yin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa yin no// //shu bhaṃ// ༄// swasti sid+dhaṃ/ sa skya pa la jo zhal zhes// yongs su grags pa'i srol 'byed byon// kun mkhyen zhes pa dol po bas// rnam par bshad pa'i lta sgom la// sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung gi

/mthar thug lta ba gcig tu nges// gcig po 'khor lo gsum pa yi// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid do// stong nyid ngos 'dzin med dgag la// 'chad pa rtsod ldan lugs yin gyi// rdzogs ldan dbang byas bka' dang ni// bstan bcos kun las ma bshad gsung*// des na gzhan stong zab mo'i chos// byams pa thog med kyis gsungs shing*// klu sgrub kyang ni bzhed nges pa// rgyal bas 'khor lo gsum par bshad// 'di nyid thos dang bsam pa yis// gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs pa yang*// shes rab pha rol phyin pa las// gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de// yin phyir de des stong zhes gsungs// chos dbyings mig sogs gnas lugs la// yod pa kun btags gzugs sogs kyi// stong pa gnas lugs rang bzhin phyir// de de stong pa zhes bshad do// de don sgom pas nyams len tshe// mnyam par bzhag pas la bzlo dang*// rjes kyi shes pas shan phye nas// tha snyad 'dogs par byed pa'o// mnyam par bzhag tshe yod med sogs// spros pa cir yang mi 'char zhing*// myong rig tsam du gsal ba ni// pha rol phyin dang thun mong ste// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i thabs mkhas las// stong pa nyid kyi gzugs sgra sogs// gsal ba'ang chos kyi dbyings nyid kyi// gzugs dang sgra la sogs par bzhed// de yi yul can ye shes dang*// kun btags gzugs sogs kyis stong phyir// ye shes nyid dang dam pa'i don// yin no zhes ni gsal bar 'chad// rjes su tha snyad byed pa na// kun btags rang gi ngo bos stong*// gzhan dbang sgyu ma lta bu dang*// yongs grub don dam bden no zhes// bden dang bden grub khyad mi 'byed// zla ba grags pa sngon gyi tshe// rtsod ldan paṇ+ḍi ta yin kyang*// sngags la zhugs pa'i bstan bcos rnams// brtsom pa'i tshe na rdzogs ldan no// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// gzhung ni dbu ma dngos min zhes// dpyod chen 'dis 'chad sngon gyi tshe// bsam gtan pa rnams phal cher ro// sems can thams cad gdod ma nas// stobs sogs yon tan kun tshang ba'i// sangs rgyas yin kyang glo bur gyi// dri ma sbyang phyir 'bad dgos zhes// blo bzang 'dis 'chad sngon tshe dang*// da ltar dus kyi bka' rgyud par// grags pa phal cher de ltar 'chad// bshad rgyud 'dzin rnams 'di la rtog

/de yang rngog lo chen po ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi snying po la// dgongs te mdo las de ltar bshad// snying po dngos ni stong nyid gsung*// sa skya paṇa chen sangs rgyas kyi// snying po'ang dgongs pa can yin te// snying po dngos ni rdzogs sangs rgyas// dgongs gzhi stong pa nyid ces gsungs// dol po ba yi bshad rgyud ni// sa skya pa las 'ongs pa yin// gnyis pa bu ston rin chen grub// bod du 'gyur ba'i gsung rab la// 'di yis ma mkhyen ci yang med// de bas mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug go /'di pa'i lta sgom spyod pa 'di// pha rol phyin gzhung 'chad pa'i tshe// lta ba ngo bo nyid med smra// sgom pas kyang ni de goms byed// spyod pa pha rol phyin pa sogs// tshad ldan gzhung las gsungs de bzhin// sngags kyi lta ba'i myong bya ni// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid de// de la spros pa 'gog pa yi// rigs pa klu sgrub gzhung bzhin bzhed// so sor sdud pa'i mngon sum la// bsam gtan sngon du ma song na// stong nyid mngon sum ma mthong phyir// snang cha kun rdzob bden zhes 'chad// bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yi// rnam gzhag sa skya paṇa chen ltar// lung dang rigs pa du ma yis// dgongs pa can du bkral nas 'chad// bde gshegs snying po sgra ji bzhin// myang 'das chen mor bshad rlom mod// de na ji bzhin min pa'i sgrar// bshad pa shin tu gsal zhes gsung*// gzhung chen lung nas ma gsungs pa'i// rdzogs ldan rtsod ldan rnam gzhag dang*// 'khor lo bar pa rtsod ldan gyi// lung du 'chad pa 'di mi rigs// theg chen rgyud bla'i bstan bcos su// dri mar bcas pa'i de bzhin nyid// byang chub dngos su bshad pa med// ces sogs rgyas par gsungs pa yin// mkhas pa 'di ni snyigs dus su// gzhung chen 'chad la bka' drin che// legs gsungs 'dul ba'i chos rnams dang*// bstan pa'i nying khung gsang ba 'dus// ngo mtshar dus kyi 'khor lo la// 'di bas rnam bshad rgya cher ba// legs par bshad pa de med na// phal cher mun pa'i gling du 'khyams// de la brten nas mang pos kyang*// myur du goms nas 'chad par nus// 'di yi bshad pa'i dga' ston la// ltos pa med par rnal 'byor rgyud// dgongs 'grel bcas pa mtha' dag gi

/ya mtshan ltad mo ma lus pa// sus kyang blta bar nus ma yin// rang gzhan stong pa'i 'chad tshul tsam// jo zhal rtsod pa'i gzhi min te// sngags kyi nges don bu lugs pa'ang*// gzhan stong nyid du bshad phyir ro// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gangs can ljongs su lung dang ni// rigs pa'i tshul la blo sbyangs pa'i// bshad rgyud tshul lugs gnyis byon te// sa rngog ces byar grags pa'o// rngog gi gtsug lag khang btab nas// lo grangs bcu bdun phrag gnyis tshe// rgyal bas lung bstan lo chen gyis// lung dang rigs pa'i srol chen phye// lta ba klu sgrub lugs bzang po// rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i rigs pa yi// shing rta'i srol chen der drangs nas// stong nyid bdud rtsi ston par mdzad// sgom pa rnam 'grel mdzad pa yi// rigs pas drangs pa'i stong pa nyid// a ti shas mdzad dbu ma yi// man ngag ji bzhin goms par mdzad// tshul gsum rtags la ma brten par// dngos smra'i log rtog bkag tsam gyis// stong nyid rtogs par mi bzhed cing*// sgyu ma rig sgrub kyang mi bzhed// stong nyid tshad mas gzhal ba dang*// don dam blo yi yul du yang*// mi bzhed mod kyang zla grags kyi// rigs pas dgag bya mi 'gog cing*// legs ldan 'byed kyi rigs pa yang*// lhag chod gnas dang rang rgyud kyis// bden med bsgrubs na rtag chad kyi// g.yang du lhung bar 'gyur zhes bzhed// spyod pa mdo rgyan bslab btus dang*// spyod 'jug dgongs 'grel bcas de bzhin// 'bras bu chos sku mnyam rjes dang*// gzhan snang sprul pa'i sku gsum mo// snga ma ye shes stong nyid dang*// ro gcig blo yi 'jug pa zhi// phyi ma 'khrul pa'i snang ba yang*// 'char mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// sprul sku gzhan snang tsam yin par// mdo dang rgyud blar gsungs zhes bzhed// rnam 'grel rgyan dang bcas pa yang*// klu sgrub lugs kyi dbu ma ste// gcig dang du bral rigs pa yis// dgag bya bkag nas gnyis stong gi

/ye shes lhag mar bzhag pa de// byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos// legs par gtan la phab ces gsungs// rnam par nges pa'i rnam bshad du// gzhung rtsom rnams kyi blo la yang*// ji bzhin legs par mi gsal ba// nyid kyis legs par bshad ces gsungs// de nas lung dang rigs pa yi// srol chen 'dzin pa brgyud mar byon// rngog lo'i bshad srol de tshugs nas// lo grangs brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag /lon tshe sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas// lung dang rigs pa'i bshad srol btsugs// sngon byon bshad rgyud sgrub rgyud pa// kun gyi ma dag sun phyung nas// lung dang rigs pa'i gnas rnams dang*// smin grol gnas rnams gsal bar mdzad// khyad par tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi// lta ba'i mthar thug rnam brdzun dang*// gnas skabs mdo sems gzhung ji bzhin// bshad pas bsdus pa'i lugs rnams bkag /rnam bshad mdzad pa phal cher yang*// srol chen 'di las ma brgyud pa// deng sang bar du gzhan med phyir// chos 'di'i dar mdzad de kho na// lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe// gcig dang du bral la sogs pa// thal rang gzhung gi rigs pa dang*// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung gnyis ka bzhed// snang ba sems kyis bzung ba dang*// sems snang sgyu mas 'dzin pa khegs// sgyu ma brjod bral zhes bya ba// nyams su myong byar bzhed pa yin// chos dbyings dge ba min zhes pa// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i stong nyid ste// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyang*// mdo rgyu'i dge bar 'dis mi bzhed// mkhas pa 'di byon snga rol tu// tshig rgyan sdeb sbyor mngon brjod sogs// rig gnas 'ga' zhig sngon ma 'gyur// de dus 'di yis de bsgyur nas// paṇa chen zhes bya'i mtshan 'dis thob// paṇa chen 'di yi bka' drin las// shong dang dpang sogs mkhas mang pos// yongs rdzogs rig pa'i gnas lnga yis// gangs can ljongs su nyin mor mdzad// deng sang bar du rnam 'grel gyi// bshad rgyun 'di las ma brgyud med// byams pa'i chos lnga rngog lo las// rigs par brgyud pa 'di kho na// 'dul mngon bshad pa snga dar gyi// bstan pa'i dus nas ma chad tsam// 'di ni thub bstan gtsug lag khang*// rigs par 'degs pa'i ka chen bzhi// 'di la 'pho 'chug med de srid// phan bde'i 'byung gnas ring du gnas//

//shu bhaṃ// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gangs can ljongs su bstan pa yi// nyin byed thun mtshams su gyur tshe// shar phyogs btsong kha'i dpyod chen gyi// cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla 'od shar// lta sgom gnas la sngon rabs dang*// mi mthun mang yang spyod pa'i gnas// mdo dang 'dul ba'i gzhung bzhin gsungs// mdo sngags theg pa che chung gi /lta ba'i mthar thug dbu ma'i lugs// de yang dpal ldan zla ba yi// gzhung las gzhan na med ces 'chad// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i don// rang nyid rang gis stong pa la// bshad na chad pa'i mthar lhung phyir// gzugs sogs chos rnams kun mkhyen gyi// tshad mas gzigs pa gzhir bzhag nas// rtags kyi dgag bya bden grub la// rang bzhin zhes bshad de yis stong*// chos kun med pa'ang ma yin na// 'gal la mi 'khrul tshad mar 'gyur// de phyir spros pa zhes bya ba// rang bzhin nyid las gzhan mi 'chad// dbu ma'i rigs pas btsal ba na// gang du yang ni ma rnyed pa// de nyid don dam de rtogs pa'i// shes rab lta ba yin par 'dod// bden sgrub btsal bas ma rnyed pa// de la bden med rnyed ces bya// bden med rnyed kyang ma rnyed ces// bya ba de ni 'dis mi bzhed// sgom pa yid byed dang bral ba// rgya nag mkhan po'i lugs yin phyir// bden med nyid du zhen pa'i blo// sgom la dpyad sgom zhes byar 'dod// gsal stong tsam la 'dzin med du// 'jog pa mu stegs la yod phyir// sngon dus bod kyi sgom chen la// rmongs pa'i gnyen po med ces 'chad// rigs pas lan mang dpyad gyur kyang*// sgom dus yid byed dang bral na// zhi gnas tsam las ma 'das phyir// srid pa'i mtha' las 'gongs mi nus// lhag mthong so sor rtog pa yi// shes rab nyid la bshad pa'i phyir// rtog dpyod bral ba'i lhag mthong ni// hā shang lugs las gzhan min gsungs// bde gsal mi rtog ces 'dod pa// zhi lhag gang du'ang mi rung ste// bsam gtan gsum pa las 'das dang*// 'dod pa'i khams na de mi srid// rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga la// gang shar stong gzugs shes 'dod pa'ang*// phyi bltas shes pa'i snang yul ni// ting 'dzin yul du 'chad mi nus// de sogs lta sgom gsang sngags kyi// gnas rnams rang gi rigs pa dang*// lung mang po dang sbyar byas nas// sngon gyi lugs gnyis 'dor dgos gsungs// deng dus gangs can ljongs 'di na// phal cher lugs 'di dang du len// de la sdang zer mang pos kyang*// de gzhung ji bzhin sun ma phyung*// lkog tu gyur pa'i stong pa nyid// rtags la ma brten mi rtogs gsungs// man ngag lugs dang mi mthun yang*// rngog lo'i rnam bshad dang mthun no//

//shu bhaṃ// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ shar phyogs btsong kha'i lugs gsar de// shar nas lo brgya lon pa'i tshe// sngon gyi lugs gnyis 'di ltar 'chad// chos can tshad mas grub pa dag /tha snyad tsam du ma grub pa'i// dgag byas stong pa rang stong gi /tshul ci gzhan stong 'dod lugs kyi// tha shal tsam las 'das pa med// gdod nas yod ma myong ba yi// kun rdzob bkag pas chad 'gyur na// ye nas yod ma myong ba yi// mo gsham bu la'ang cis mi mtshungs// tshad mas grub pa'i don 'ga' zhig /rigs pas dpyad tshe ma mthong na// stong nyid dngos po'i 'jig rgyur ni// ha cang thal ba zla bas 'phangs// bden med rnam dpyad du bkag pas// bden grub yongs spyod la 'grub na// dgag bya 'gog tshul med dgag las// ma 'das zhes pa tshig tu zad// rten 'brel yin na grub dgos pa// 'di yang zla ba'i lugs ma yin// phan tshun ltos grub ma grub pa'i// don du zla bas gsal bar bshad// med mtha' sel ba'i rigs pa yis// yod par grub dgos yin na ni// mtha' gnyis sel ba'i rigs pa zhes// bshad pa 'gal la mi 'khrul 'gyur// rigs des tha snyad du med dang*// bden par grub pa 'gog zer mod// 'o na gnyis min bkag pa yis// gnyis ka rab tu grub par 'gyur// rang mtshan rang bzhin zhes bya ba// stong gzhi chos can du bshad tshe// khyed kyi tshad mas grub min nam// rtags kyi dgag bya ji ltar yin// dgag byar bshad pa'i rang bzhin ni// su zhig gi ni rang bzhin yin// chos rnams kun la kun rdzob dang*// don dam rang bzhin gnyis ma gtogs// bden grub ces bya gang gi yang*// rang bzhin nyid du bshad pa med// bden grub de'i rang bzhin na// rang bzhin med pa ji ltar 'grub// don la rang bzhin ma yin kyang*// rtog ngor rang bzhin nyid ce na// chos can tshad mas grub pa la// nam yang tshad mas mi 'grub pa'i// rtog pas sgro btags bkag pa ni// stong pa nyid kyi tha shal lo// bden med nges pa'i snga rol tu// bden grub sngon du nges dgos shes// zhes pa btags pa'i dngos la sogs// spyod 'jug lung gi don min te// ltos grub min pa'i chos 'ga' yang*// med phyir bden grub bkag pa'i tshe// bden med kyang ni yod min zhes// bya ba lung gi dgongs pa yin// mdor na ngo bo nyid med kyi// stong nyid 'chad tshul phyis byon 'di// gzhung na med pa lta ci smos// bod rgan sus kyang bshad pa med// sgom pa zhi lhag gnyis po yi// ngos 'dzin tshul la 'dir dpyad pa// tshul min yid la byed pa yi// rnam par rtog pa tsam zhi ba'i// gsal cha zhi gnas su bzhed na// tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yi// rnam par rtog pa'i gsal cha ni// bkag pa min pa'i zhi gnas kyang*// khyed kyis 'dod pas rnam g.yeng 'gyur// de yang 'dod na hwa shang gi

/zhi gnas tshul du thal min nam// dran shes ngar dang mi ldan pa'i// gsal cha bying bar khyed kyis bshad// lhag mthong lta ci zhig nas kyang*// khyed la rtog par thal min nam// mdo dang bstan bcos lung mang pos// lhag mthong rtog pa'i ngo bor 'chad// khyed kyis drangs pa'i lung mang po'i// sgras zin bsam byung shes rab ste// lhag mthong dngos ni sgom byung gi /shes rab yin par kun gyis bzhed// lhag mthong ngo bo rtog dpyod na// zhi lha zung 'jug ji ltar 'chad// zhi gnas kyang ni rtog dpyod na// zhi gnas rgod pa nyid du thal// dpyad tshe sgom tshe cung zad cig /mnyam par 'jog ces khyed kyis 'dod// mnyam par bzhag tshe dpyod pa tsam// med na hwa shang sgom du thal// yod na dpyad sgom khyad par ci// shing gnyis bsreg pa las byung ba'i// me yis de nyid bsreg pa'i dpes// mnyam gzhag rtog dpyod bral bar bshad// mnyam par bzhag pa'i lhag mthong ci// mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul bar// 'chad dgos min nam mngon sum dang*// lhag mthong gzhi mthun gang nas btsal// pha rol phyin 'dir bsam byung gis// dpyad pa sngon du ma song ba'i// lhag mthong dngos gzhi mi 'dod phyir// rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags// dper na sems gnas thabs dgu la// zhi gnas ming gis btags de bzhin// mdor na lhag mthong rnam gnyis te// so sor brtag dang mi g.yo ba// zhes bya pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyi// sgom rim gzhung las 'byung ba nges// gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa yi// ye shes dam pa'i don nyid du// gzhung chen dag las gsungs pa'i phyir// de nyams myong ba'i lhag mthong gis// sgrib kun sel bar rgyud bla dang*// rnal 'byor chen po'i gzhung las gsungs// de las gzhan na 'od gsal dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan yod ma yin// de rtogs byed pa'i thabs la ni// pha rol phyin par thos bsam dang*// sngags su dbang gi rim pa gsungs// rgyas par gzhan du bshad las shes// zhes pa 'di ni phyis byon dang*// sngon byung lta sgom khyad par te// gang bden lung rigs man ngag dang*// nyams len mdzad rnams dpang por bzhugs// zhes pa shākya mchog ldan gyis// bden brdzun shan 'byed phyir du sbyar//

//maṅga laṃ// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// sgom chen ye shes bzang po'i dris lan lta ba so so'i ngos 'dzin tshul nges don gnad kyi lde mig bzhugs// na mo bud+dhā ya/ gangs can pa dag gis lta ba so so'i ngos 'dzin/ nges don gnad kyi lde mig ces bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen ba lta ba sna tshogs kyi thibs po sel mdzad nyid la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can ljongs su lta ba yi// zhal 'dzin so sor gang smra ba// kun kyang bdag med rtogs blo yis// rmongs pa'i mun chen sel bar mthun// bdag med pa dang de rtogs pa'i// thabs dang bdag med rtogs pa yi// ngos 'dzin dbu ma'i gzhung lugs dang*// rgyud dang man ngag dbye bas gsum// dang po 'khor lo bar pa yi// dgongs 'grel dbye bas rnam gnyis te// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma dang*// ngo bo gnyis med smra ba'o// dang po 'khor lo gsum pa yis// sher phyin dgongs pa bkral ba dang*// byams pa'i gzhung dang klu sgrub kyi// bstod pa'i tshogs kyi dbang du byas// 'di la'ang thos bsam lta ba dang*// nyams myong lta ba mtha' gcig dang*// gnyis po so sor 'byed pa yi// dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su byung*// dang po byams chos rnam gsum dang*// thogs med mched kyi gzhung ji bzhin// phyi ma mngon rtogs rgyan gzhung gi /rjes 'brangs ma lus pa rnams so// de yi shes byed mtha' bral gyi// rigs pas gtan la phab byas nas// skye med gsum gyi shes rnam nyid// nyams su myong byar bshad las shes// ngo bo nyid med smra ba yi// rang gzhung tshugs par 'chad byed ni// legs ldan zla ba grags pa ste// gnyis po'i lta ba mthar thug mthun// nyams su myong bya'i stong nyid kyang*// rigs pas gtan la gang phab pa// de las gzhan du ma bshad phyir// med par dgag pa kho na'o// slob dpon 'di dag kun rdzob las// ma gtogs chos gzhan mi bzhed la// kun rdzob kyang ni 'khrul snang phyir// mthar thug spros pa kun dang bral// spros bral thams cad mkhyen blo yi// spyod yul nyid du khas blangs na// thams cad mkhyen blo rtog pa'am// spros bral rang mtshan nyid du 'gyur// lugs 'dir gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// gnas skabs gsum ka stong pa nyid// med par dgag las ma 'das phyir// rang rig ye shes khas mi len// de lta na yang kun rdzob kyi// snang ba ji ltar grags pa bzhin// tshogs bsags pa las 'bras dus su// gzhan snang sku gnyis lhun grub bo// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la// rang snang kun rdzob mi 'char yang*// kun gyi gnas tshul mkhyen nas ni// lung ston nus phyir thabs cad mkhyen// med dgag nam mkha' lta bu de// rtogs pa'i thabs ni thos bsam dang*// mos pa yid byed kyis goms pa// de las mthong lam ye shes 'byung*// de tshe stong nyid mngon sum du// rtogs blo lta bar 'chad mod kyang*// yul can stong nyid du 'dres pas// ma mthong ba la mthong zhes brjod// tshad ma gnyis pas stong pa nyid// rtogs pa min zhes legs ldan dang*// zla ba'i rjes 'brang gis bshad pa// thal rang gzhung lugs kun dang mthun// gnyis pa sngags kyi rgyud gzhung nas// bshad pa'i nyams myong stong pa nyid// byams chos rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i// gzhung dang mthun par 'dir bshad bya// 'di la rigs pas dpyad pa yi// stong nyid sgom byar ma bshad de// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje nyid// goms pas gzung 'dzin rtog pa sel// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// gdod ma'i shes pa rgyu yi rgyud// 'di nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa yi// lha dang sngags kyi sgrub gzhir 'chad// rtogs bya'i lta ba 'di nyid de// de rtogs byed pa'i thabs mchog ni// ye shes 'bebs dang dbang bskur bar// 'dod kyi rigs pas de ma sgrub// gnyis med ye shes nyams myong ba'i// rang rig ye shes lta ba dang*// thabs kyi rgyud du 'chad pa ste// thog mar gang skyes dpe'i ye shes// gang snang ye shes su 'char ba// shes rab 'di la skyed rim gyi// lta ba zhes dang 'khor 'das gnyis// zung du 'jug pa zhes byar bshad// 'di yi rtogs byed gsang sngags su// bum dbang 'khor dang bcas yin phyir// dbang gi lta bar bshad mod kyang*// phar phyin pa la'ang de med min// bum dbang las thob ye shes de// tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug skur// sgrub byed rang byin rlabs pa yi// rim pa sgom pa rdzogs rim mo// rtogs bya lhan skyes ye shes ni// mngon sum rtogs byed rang byin rlabs// yin gyi gzhan la de med pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// dbang bskur rnam pa bzhi po yang*// lhan skyes ye shes gcig pu nyid// rtogs pa'i thabs su khyad med cing*// rtogs blo'ang lta bar mtshungs mod kyang*// skyed rim dus su ye shes nyid// lhar sgom pa dang rdzogs rim du// lha nyid ye shes su sgom pa'i// dbye bas rim gnyis sgom tshul shes// rtogs bya 'khor 'das dbyer med nyid// rtogs byed dbang bskur rim pa yi// dbang bzhi po dang rjes 'brel ba'i// lta ba so sor bshad pa tsam// phar phyin theg pa'i spros bral dang*// gzung 'dzin gnyis med ye shes las// lhag pa'i lha yul 'dir mi 'chad// rtogs byed khyad 'phags bde ba che// gsum pa gangs can 'dir grags pa'i// man ngag lugs mang snang 'gyur pa// rdzogs dang phyag rgya che zhi byed// lam 'bras rim lnga sbyor drug sogs// rang rang lta ba'i zhal 'dzin ni// so sor 'chad pa 'di lta ste// rdzogs chen theg pa rim dgu'i rtse// 'di dang mnyam pa gzhan na med// de rtogs pa yi thabs mchog ni// rang gi man ngag las 'byung gsungs// phyag rgya chen po lta ba la// chen po gsum gyis ma reg pas// kun las khyad 'phags de rtogs pa'i// thabs ni bla ma'i mos gus so// sdug bsngal rab tu zhi byed kyi// lta ba dbu ma la med cing*// rtogs pa'i thabs ni bla ma yis// sems ngo sprod pa yin zhes gsungs// lam 'bras pa rnams gzhan gsum po'i// lta ba phar phyin las ma 'das// de la dbang dang rjes 'brel ba'i// lta grub rnam pa brgyad yod gsungs// rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa ba// kha gcig so sor bsdus pa yi// stong pa nyid kyi gzugs mthong ba// de nyid lta ba mchog tu bzhed// rim lnga pa yi 'od gsal gyi// ngos 'dzin gangs can phyi rabs pa// dbu ma thal 'gyur du smra ba'i// lugs las gzhan du yod ma yin// gzhan yang dbu ma'i rigs pa yis// ma dpyad stong nyid go chod po// gang na'ang yod min thos bsam gyis// rigs pas phu thag chod par byos// de lta min na hwa shang gi

/lta ba nyid las ma 'das pas// mkhas pa pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyi// phyogs sngar brtags pa de yin zer// de dag rnams la gzu bo'i blos// yin pa bzhin du bsam bya ba// zhi phyag rdzogs pa rnam gsum gyi// lta ba'i yul ni gcig tu nges// gcig pu rang sems 'od gsal ba// gdod ma nyid nas glo bur gyi// dri mas gos pa med der 'chad// 'di ni mdo rgyud kun dang mthun// de rtogs pa yi shes rab ni// lta ba yin te mdo rgyud las// so sor rang rig ye shes dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan nyid du bshad// rtogs byed thabs la sa skya pas// dpyad pa 'ga' zhig mdzad pa dang*// gzhan gyis kyang ni dpyod pa'o// dang po lhan skyes ye shes de// rtogs byed pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsang sngags gang gi lugs su byed// gnyis ka min na blun po yi// zhi phyag rdzogs gsum bsgom par song*// pha rol phyin pa'i lugs byed na// thos bsam rigs pa sngon 'gro dgos// gsang sngags yin na dbang bskur dang*// rjes su 'brel ba dgos zhes gsungs// de la snga mas lan 'debs pa// sngon gyi bag chags bzang po dang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni// zung 'jug phyag rgya che rtogs pa// gzhung dang mthun nam mi mthun kyang*// rang gi nyams myong tshad mas grub// man ngag mchog gi lugs yin no// zhes gsungs gzhan gyi dpyad pa ni// dpyad pa sngon du ma song bar// myong rig tsam la sems 'jog pa// de ni zhi gnas stengs po ste// nyon mongs gnyen por mi 'gro zer// de la kho bos lan gdab pa// de ltar yin na bde mchog dang*// gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'od gsal gyi// rim pa'ang de nyid du 'gyur te// de skabs dpyad pa med phyir ro// des na rang sems 'od gsal ba// 'di nyid ye shes chen po ste// 'di yi rtogs pa gong 'phel na// rmongs chen gud du lus pa med// lam 'bras las gsungs lta ba ni// lta yul nyid yin de rtogs pa'i// lta ba dngos la grub mthar bshad// skabs 'di snang ba sems so zhes// man ngag pa kun mthun mod kyi// gzhung bzhin 'chad na sems tsam pa'i// lugs las gong du 'das pa med// man ngag lugs bzhin 'dir bshad na// gzhi dus 'od gsal ba yi sems// sgyu ma'i snang bar bshad pa la// gsal ba zhes ni brjod pa yin// ji ltar snang ba der med pa// de la stong pa zhes su brjod// zung du 'jug la'ang de nyid de// mdor na rang stong lhad med la// zung 'jug zhes bya'i tha snyad med// zung 'jug gzhan stong lugs las 'byung*// rim lnga pa yi 'od gsal yang*// rang stong gzhung bzhin 'chad mi nus// sems kyi rdo rje gang yin pa// de la nges pa'i don du bshad// de ltar de brtsams pa las ni// byung ba'i dge ba gang thob pa// des ni lus can thams cad kyi// rang rig rang gsal de goms nas// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes kyi// khang bzang nyams dga' de bzung nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi// rgyal mtshan mthon po 'dzin byed shog
